items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I knew I'd connect all the tabloids, the Camelot Jenkins. I played one of the largest dancers, Oriental dance, the Camelot Jenkins.

ctx.x: Well I used to play all the ball and I knew all the tabloids, tabloids. See, after some stand you knew it, you see. You didn't know how to conduct the tabloids. See they used to practice me, you see. I would go down, like I was going to play a dance next week, I had to go down, especially to a meeting and look at them, see. Then I'd have to take the band. Yeah. So I had to come back and play the band. Then I'd take them down. I knew I'd connect all the tabloids, the Camelot Jenkins. I played one of the largest…
People tell me that too. It was a popular band, that tuxedo. Popular. I just kept on straight.
